newsitem.title: USA: Atchison foundries report Q2 operating income.
newsitem.headline: Atchison foundries report Q2 operating income.

text.p: Atchison Casting Corp, which incurred losses last year at some of its foundries, said Tuesday operations have improved and its foundries generated operating income in the October through December period.

"Good progress has been made towards the goals set by management at the three respective foundries. All three had positive operating income in this year's second quarter," said Hugh Aiken, chief executive officer, in a statement.

Earlier today, the company reported earnings for its fiscal second quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose to $2.4 million or $0.43 a share from $332,000 or $0.06 in the second quarter a year ago. Prior year net income included $0.06 per share of non-recurring flood insurance proceeds.
Sales increased 51 percent to $61.6 million in this year's second quarter, from $40.7 million in the prior year period.

"Last year's earnings report reflected losses incurred following the acquisition of Canadian Steel Foundries in Montreal and during the start-up of Amite Foundry & Machine in Louisiana, as well as by the conversion of a portion of the production at the Atchison/St. Joe Division from military to commercial castings," said Aiken.
"In addition, the acquisitions of LA Die Casting, Canada Alloy Castings and Pennsylvania Steel Foundry & Machine, which were completed during the second quarter, contributed to earnings," he said.
Atchison Casting produces iron, steel and non-ferrous castings for a variety of equipment, capital goods and consumer markets.
Shares of Atchison Casting were trading up 1/8 to 17.
